title: Tentai Show (Spiral Galaxies) Canonical Representation
description: A width x height grid with dashed interior lines and a solid outer border. Dots (galaxy centers) sit at cell centers, edge midpoints, or grid corners, encoded in doubled coordinates where cell (r, c) center is (2r+1, 2c+1). Each dot is an open (white) or filled (black) circle; color is cosmetic. The solver divides the grid into connected regions, one dot each, with 180-degree rotational symmetry about the dot.

color.description: 0 = open/white circle, 1 = filled/black circle. Cosmetic only.
